Include pinned source/hunk reads, DiffTree updates and read/navigation calls.

Detail revision/node-to-hunk mappings, captured-hunk reads and navigation to proposal diagrams; sources: domain/mapping/changes/diffTree.ts and application/mapping/changes/changeSessionService.ts. Do not substitute the supplied Git excerpts for server-issued hunk IDs.
